items.practice: Track, document and report incidents to designated officials and/or authorities both internal and external to the organization.
items.plannedCorrectiveAction:
→ M365: Use Sentinel incidents for classification, tracking, and documentation; configure incident comments and task tracking
  → Portal: portal.azure.com > Sentinel > Incidents
[CMMC Guidance] - Prefer tenant-wide controls.
- Document deviations and compensating controls with rationale.
- Use repeatable exports/logs instead of one-off screenshots.
[Assessment Design] Design for auditability: Implement the control so evidence can be produced on demand (policy + configuration export + operational logs) without manual reconstruction.

[Deliverable] Incident Tracking & Reporting Procedure
  Content: Incident report fields: ID, date/time, reporter, category, affected systems, CUI impact, severity
  Content: Tracking workflow: report → triage → investigate → contain → remediate → close → lessons-learned
  Content: Evidence preservation: what to collect, chain-of-custody, forensic image requirements
  Content: Reporting triggers: when to escalate internally, when to notify DoD, when to involve law enforcement
  Content: Post-incident review: timeline, root cause, corrective actions, plan updates needed
  Assessor: All incidents logged with complete required fields
  Assessor: Incident timeline and response actions documented for each event
  Assessor: Evidence preserved per retention and chain-of-custody requirements
  Assessor: Closed incidents have post-incident review with lessons learned and corrective actions
  Create with: Microsoft Sentinel for incident management and automated tracking. ServiceNow or Jira for ticketing with SLA monitoring. Power Automate for escalation rules.
  Ref: NIST SP 800-171 3.6.2; NIST SP 800-61 Rev 2; NIST SP 800-53 IR-5, IR-6
[Deliverable] Compliance Procedure Document
  Content: Purpose, scope, and when this procedure applies
  Content: Step-by-step process flow with decision points and responsible roles
  Content: Required inputs, outputs, and record-keeping at each step
  Content: Exception handling and escalation path
  Content: Review cycle: at least annual, update triggers (system changes, incidents, audit findings)
  Assessor: Procedure documented and accessible to all responsible personnel
  Assessor: Steps specific enough to be followed consistently by different operators
  Assessor: Records demonstrate the procedure is actually followed in practice
  Assessor: Procedure reviewed and updated at least annually
  Create with: Power Automate for workflow automation and approval routing. SharePoint for procedure hosting with version control. Microsoft Forms for structured data capture at each process step.
  Ref: NIST SP 800-171; NIST SP 800-53
[Automated Evidence Collection] Service: Microsoft Sentinel
  Cadence: Weekly export (daily for high-security environments)
  Command: Get-AzSentinelIncident -WorkspaceName {ws} -ResourceGroupName {rg} | Group Status | Select Name,Count | Export-Csv incident_status_summary.csv
  Produces: incident_tracking_procedure, incident_report_template, sample_incident_records
  Manual verification: portal.azure.com > Sentinel > Incidents

items.practice: Ensure that organizational systems containing CUI are protected during and after personnel actions such as terminations and transfers.
items.deficiencyDescription: Leaver (S2 Leaver - disable account and remove access) and mover (S2 Mover - review group access on department change) workflows enabled and scheduled; 1 disabled account(s), none holding a directory role
items.plannedCorrectiveAction:
→ M365: Document access revocation procedures for transfers/termination; reference Entra ID Lifecycle Workflows
  → M365: Configure Entra ID Lifecycle Workflows with leaver triggers to automatically disable accounts and revoke sessions
  → Portal: entra.microsoft.com > Identity > Users > Lifecycle Workflows > Leaver workflow
[CMMC Guidance] - Prefer tenant-wide controls.
- Document deviations and compensating controls with rationale.
- Use repeatable exports/logs instead of one-off screenshots.
[Assessment Design] Design for auditability: Implement the control so evidence can be produced on demand (policy + configuration export + operational logs) without manual reconstruction.
[Common Pitfall] Policies exist but are not enforced by configuration.
[Common Pitfall] Evidence is ad-hoc (screenshots) instead of repeatable exports/logs.
[Common Pitfall] Scope boundaries exclude systems that still touch CUI workflows.
[Deliverable] Personnel Termination & Transfer Procedure
  Content: Trigger events: voluntary termination, involuntary termination, transfer, reassignment
  Content: Same-day actions: disable all system accounts, revoke VPN and remote access tokens
  Content: Physical access: collect badges, keys, access devices; deactivate in badge system
  Content: Property return: laptops, mobile devices, removable media, CUI hardcopy materials
  Content: CUI data disposition: archive or verified destruction of CUI in departing user custody
  Content: Exit interview: security debriefing on ongoing NDA and CUI handling obligations
  Content: Offboarding checklist with IT, security, facilities, and manager sign-offs
  Assessor: All system accounts disabled within 24 hours of separation (same day for involuntary)
  Assessor: Physical access devices collected and deactivated with documented confirmation
  Assessor: Completed offboarding checklists on file for all departures in review period
  Assessor: CUI materials returned or destruction documented with witness
  Create with: Entra ID Lifecycle Workflows triggered by HR termination event → auto-disable accounts, revoke sessions, remove group memberships. Power Automate orchestrates multi-system checklist to IT, security, and facilities.
  Ref: NIST SP 800-171 3.9.2; NIST SP 800-53 PS-4, PS-5
[Automated Evidence Collection] Service: Compliance Manager
  Cadence: On policy change + quarterly review
  Produces: termination_procedure, access_revocation_checklist

  Command: Get-MgAuditLogDirectoryAudit -Filter "activityDisplayName eq 'Disable account'" -Top 50 | Select ActivityDateTime,TargetResources | Export-Csv termination_audit.csv
  Produces: automated_deprovisioning_config, termination_audit_logs
  Manual verification: entra.microsoft.com > Identity > Users > Lifecycle Workflows > Leaver workflow

items.practice: Develop, document and periodically update System Security Plans (SSPs) that describe system boundaries, system environments of operation, how security requirements are implemented and the relationships with or connections to other systems.
items.plannedCorrectiveAction:
→ M365: Develop SSP using Compliance Manager as framework; document all control implementations referencing M365 configurations

  → M365: Schedule SSP review using Compliance Manager assessment update cycle; document all changes
  → Portal: compliance.microsoft.com > Compliance Manager > Assessments > Update

- Document deviations and compensating controls with rationale.

[Deliverable] System Security Plan (SSP)
  Content: System identification: name, description, owner, operational status, authorization boundary
  Content: System categorization: CUI types processed, stored, and transmitted
  Content: System environment: architecture diagrams, network topology, interconnections, data flows
  Content: Control implementation statements: how each CMMC practice is satisfied (implemented, planned, inherited, N/A with rationale)
  Content: Roles and responsibilities: security roles, organizational chart, contact information
  Content: Continuous monitoring strategy: what is monitored, tools used, review frequency, update triggers
  Assessor: SSP exists and covers all in-scope systems and authorization boundaries

  Create with: Compliance Manager for SSP control-status tracking aligned to CMMC. SharePoint for document management with approval workflows and version history. Power Automate for annual review reminders.
